plugin.name: Photo Studio
look.unavailable: Looks are not available on this client.
lut.bad: {0} is not a valid LUT (use 256×16 or 1024×32 PNG).
preset.bad: A saved look could not be read and was skipped.
ps.title: Photo Studio
ps.status.capturing4x: Capturing at 4× — encoding takes a few seconds
ps.cap.folderFallback: Folder not writable — saving to the default folder.
ps.cap.folderHintWine: Linux folders are under Z:\ (e.g. Z:\home\you\Pictures).
ps.cap.dockedAuto: Open the compact panel in the game's photo mode
ps.help.hide.hud: Hides the game's own interface while the panel is open.
ps.help.hide.overlay: Hides every Stellar window, this panel included. Press {0} to bring it back.
ps.help.hide.party: Keeps your party visible while other players are hidden.
ps.help.hide.me: Hides your character, your pet and your summons on your screen only. You can still move and fight; other players still see you.
ps.help.hide.fx.mine: Hides effects you caused — your skills, buffs and hits, and your summons' — on your screen only.
ps.help.hide.fx.party: Hides effects caused by your party members and their summons.
ps.help.hide.fx.others: Hides effects caused by players outside your party and their summons.
ps.help.hide.fx.monsters: Hides effects caused by monsters and bosses, including their warning areas. Scenery effects are never hidden.
ps.help.layerUnavailable: Not available on this client yet — this layer can't be hidden here. The capture still works.
ps.help.dockedAuto: When you open the game's own photo or selfie mode, a compact Photo Studio strip appears along the bottom with presets, a few sliders and a Capture button.
ps.look.unavailable: Looks are unavailable on this client
ps.look.pinHint: Color, White balance, LUT and Bloom stay on. Depth of field and Film grain turn off while you play.
ps.help.look.pin: Keeps your look on after you close the panel. Depth of field and Film grain are photo-only and switch off while you play.
ps.help.lookUnavailable: Not available on this client (the game changed this effect). Other looks still work.
ps.help.look.dof: Blurs what is in front of and behind the focus point. A lower f-number blurs more.
ps.help.look.color: Brightness, contrast, saturation and an overall color tint.
ps.help.look.whiteBalance: Makes the scene warmer or cooler, and shifts it toward green or magenta.
ps.help.look.lut: Applies a color-grading LUT. Put 256×16 or 1024×32 PNG strips in the LUTs folder, then press Rescan.
ps.help.look.bloom: A glow around bright lights. Threshold sets how bright something must be to glow.
ps.help.look.vignette: Darkens the edges of the frame.
ps.help.look.focusOnMe: Keeps focus on your character as you or the camera move.
ps.pre.errBuiltIn: That name belongs to a built-in preset.
ps.pre.errTaken: A preset with that name already exists.
ps.pre.importHint: Put exported .json presets in the import folder, then press Rescan.
ps.pre.exportFailed: The preset could not be exported.
ps.help.presets: Built-in presets are read-only — use Save as to keep a copy. Export writes a .json file you can share; Import reads one from the import folder.
ps.toast.folderFallback: Folder not writable — saved to the default folder.
ps.toast.retried2x: 4× didn't fit in memory — saved at 2×.
ps.pre.errTooLong: Keep names to {0} characters or fewer.
ps.pre.errBadChars: Names can't contain / \ : * ? " < > | or end with a dot.
ps.pre.importFailed: {0} could not be imported — is it a Photo Studio preset file?
ps.pre.errReserved: That name is reserved by Windows — pick another.
ps.toast.cappedSize: 4× is over the size limit on this screen — saved at 2×.
ps.q.title: Render quality
ps.help.q.title: Raises the game's own render quality for better screenshots. "Composing" applies it only while Photo Studio is open, so normal play keeps its frame rate.
ps.help.q.ssaa: Renders at 2× resolution and scales down, with temporal anti-aliasing — clean edges, no shimmer. Costs a lot of GPU.
ps.help.q.shadows: 4096 shadow map, 3 cascades, soft shadows — one step past the game's highest preset.
ps.help.q.boost: Switches to high shadows just for the moment of a screenshot. Big captures have many more pixels than the shadow map, so this keeps shadows sharp.
ps.help.q.time: Pins the in-world clock to the hour below. Interiors and cutscenes change it; Photo Studio puts it back afterwards. Only your game is affected.
ps.help.q.unavailable: Not available on this client (the game changed this setting).
hotkey.freecam: Photo Studio: free camera on / off
fc.status.off: Free camera is off. Press {0} or the button to start.
fc.hint.orbit: RMB rotate · WASD move · Space freeze · Tab fly · Esc / {0} exit (scene stays) · L / Shift+L lamp · H hide
fc.hint.fly: RMB look · WASD move · Q/E down/up · Space freeze · Tab orbit · Esc / {0} exit (scene stays) · L / Shift+L lamp · H hide
fc.help.entryHides: What the free camera hides as soon as it turns on. They stay hidden while a scene is set (frozen or people posed) and come back when you reset the scene, or when you leave the free camera with nothing set. The Capture tab's own hides still apply on top.
fc.help.entryHide.fx: Uses the Effects switches on the Capture tab.
fc.pose.none: Your emotes appear here once you are in the world.
fc.help.movement: How the free camera moves. Orbit: hold the right mouse button to rotate around the subject, wheel to zoom, WASD to slide, Q/E to lower or raise. Fly: WASD and Q/E move, the right mouse button looks. Z/C roll (Shift = fine), Shift+wheel changes the field of view, Shift is fast and Ctrl is slow. Click a character to orbit them; Backspace returns to you.
fc.help.speed: How fast the camera moves, in metres per second.
fc.help.sensitivity: How far the camera turns per mouse movement.
fc.help.leash: How far the camera may go from the character you are orbiting. At the edge it slides along instead of stopping.
fc.help.pose: Pick a pose for the selected person; ❚❚ pauses it and Moment picks the exact frame. ★ keeps a pose at the top.
fc.help.lookAt: Your character's head follows the camera while the free camera is on.
fc.toast.busy: Another plugin is using the camera right now.
fc.toast.unavailable: The free camera is not available right now.
fc.toast.error: The free camera hit an error and was turned off. Details are in the log.
fc.toast.emoteFailed: That emote could not be played right now.
fc.toast.hideallMoved: Photo Studio: “Hide everything” moved to Ctrl+F10. Alt+F10 now turns the free camera on and off.
fc.toast.hideallCleared: Photo Studio: Alt+F10 now turns the free camera on and off. “Hide everything” has no key because Ctrl+F10 is taken — set one in Settings → Hotkeys.
fc.help.invertY: Moving the mouse up looks down (and down looks up) while you hold the right mouse button.
pz.hint.select: Click a character to select · Backspace for you
pz.note.copy: Posing a local copy — only you see it. The real player is hidden until you reset the scene.
pz.failed: This character can't be posed right now.
pz.off: Posing works once you are in the world.
pz.sub.head: Head
pz.hint.cloth: Press Space to freeze cloth too
pz.help.person: Choose who to pose: ‹ › steps through the people near you, or click a character in the world while the free camera is on. Other players are posed as a copy only you can see, NPCs as a stand-in model. Everyone returns to normal when you reset the scene.
pz.help.moment: Pick the exact moment of the pose. Dragging pauses it there; ▶ plays it again.
pz.help.expression: Facial expression. With Hold on it stays until you change it; with Hold off it fades after a few seconds, as in the game.
pz.help.head: Default: the game decides. Lens: the head turns to the camera. Free: aim it with the arrows. Lock keeps a Lens target where the camera is now.
pz.help.eyes: Default: the game decides. Lens: the eyes follow the camera. Free: aim them with the arrows. Lock keeps a Lens target where the camera is now.
pz.help.rotate: Turns the person. ↺ returns them to the way they faced.
pz.full: Photo limit reached — reset someone to pose this person.
sc.help: Freeze pauses the whole game on your screen — everyone, every skill and effect, and your own character — like pausing a video. The fight carries on with the server, so anything that happened shows when you unfreeze. Freeze, posed people and hidden layers belong to the scene, not the free camera: they stay when you leave it, and only Unfreeze (or Space in the free camera) resumes the game. Reset scene, a zone change, a cutscene or turning Photo Studio off returns everything to normal.
sc.status.frozen: Frozen · {0} people posed · the whole game is paused
sc.pill.title: SCENE
fc.status.kept: Free camera is off · scene kept. Press {0} to go back.
pz.hint.selectOff: ‹ › to choose · clicking a character needs the free camera
sc.status.frozenOnly: Frozen · the whole game is paused
ps.help.frameGuide: Dims everything outside the photo's shape, with thirds lines, while the free camera is on or this tab is open. It is never in the photo.
ps.guide.title: Frame guide
ps.toast.shapeCapped: Too large for this graphics card — saved smaller (same shape).
lt.help.lamps: Place up to 8 lamps. ＋ Lamp at camera (or L in the free camera) drops one where the camera is; Shift+L moves the selected lamp there. Around / Height / Distance place it relative to the selected person. Lamps light the ground and scene, and tint characters evenly when Light people is above 0.
lt.help.person: Shape one person with a key light from a chosen direction, and a coloured rim on hair, headwear and weapons. Changed on your screen only and restored when the scene ends.
lt.lightPeople.note: How strongly lamps tint characters. While above 0, other people near any lamp (street lamps too) are tinted.
lt.noPerson: Select a person to place the lamp around them.
lt.help.key: Lights the selected person from one side. Direction turns it around them, Height raises or lowers it.
lt.help.rim: A coloured edge light. The game draws it on hair, headwear and weapons only.
lt.toast.full: 8 lamps is the most — remove one first.
lt.toast.noCamera: Start the free camera to place a lamp at it.
lt.toast.unavailable: The game didn’t accept that light change.
lt.marker.title: Lamp marker
lt.help.markers: Numbered markers show where each lamp is while the free camera is on or this tab is open. They are never in the photo.
ps.help.look.reshade: ReShade adds extra effects on screen and in your photos. Pick a preset and switch effects here; fine-tune each effect in ReShade's own menu (Home by default). Effect switches are saved in the ReShade preset.
ps.rs.notInstalled: ReShade isn't installed. In the Stellar launcher, open Photo Studio's page, tick ReShade under Dependencies, then launch Modded.
ps.rs.unreachable: A ReShade file is in the game folder, but Photo Studio can't use it. Open Photo Studio's page in the Stellar launcher to see why.
ps.help.rs.use: Turns ReShade's effects on or off, on screen and in photos.
ps.rs.savedWithLook: Saved with your Look preset: this ReShade preset and whether ReShade is on.
ps.rs.noEffects: No effects yet — download a shader pack below.
ps.rs.depthSkipped: Effects marked “depth” are left out of {0} photos.
ps.rs.depthDetail: Effects marked “depth” use screen detail in 2× and 4× photos.
ps.rs.fineTune: Fine-tune each effect in ReShade's own menu (Home by default).
ps.help.rs.packs: Shader packs are downloaded from each pack's own GitHub page, at a version we tested. Some packs need ReShade standard, which is downloaded with them.
ps.rs.note.notReady: ReShade wasn't ready in time — this photo was taken without its effects.
ps.rs.savedOnOff: ReShade's own preset is in use: your Look preset keeps only whether ReShade is on.
